messages:
Maria L: Quick heads-up — dry run for docsite cutover tomorrow 10:30 PT. Need SDK docs regen + changelog bump before cutoff. Who can own SDK regen?
Sam K: I can take SDK regen. planning to run the regen locally and open a PR by EOD.
Jin P: I’ll do the changelog bump and add the release notes snippet. will request review after tests.
Maria L: Thanks — also: branch freeze for release/v1.12.0 at 09:00 PT tomorrow. No merges after that unless explicitly approved.
Oliver: For the smoke window, who’s on-call for staging? I can run the quick smoke tests but need the deploy window pinned.
docs-bot: Reminder: staging docs build pipeline will run on pushes to `release/v1.12.0` branch. See pipeline: https://ci.internal/docs/builds/4567
Sam K: Plan: run `yarn docs:regen` -> branch `docs/sdk-regen-2387` -> PR -> merge to `release/v1.12.0`. Will add a short PR description with commands I used.
Sam K: Command I’ll run locally:
```
# regen SDK docs
git checkout -b docs/sdk-regen-2387
yarn install
yarn docs:regen --sdk
yarn test:docs
```
Jin P: Changelog note: I’ll add a bullet under "SDK" and tag the SDK owners. PR title: `chore(release): changelog for v1.12.0`
Maria L: Can you both try to have PRs opened by 18:00 PT today so we have time for reviews? Cutting off merges at 09:00 PT tomorrow.
Oliver: I’ll run the staging smoke at 10:15 PT (15 min before cutover) — checklist: build ✅, links ✅, examples ✅, samples run ✅. If anything fails, we roll back the deploy and notify #incidents.
Sam K: noted. tagging @Oliver in the PR description to coordinate smoke.
deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved — staging deploy at 10:25 PT, production cutover at 10:35 PT if staging smoke passes.
Jin P: Heads-up: one small doc lint warning from `docs/static/snippets.json` — will fix in changelog PR.
Maria L: Good. If regen PR needs a quota bump on the docs pipeline, ping @infra — we have a small slot reserved.
Sam K: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/pull/7823 — regen + preview link attached. Please quick review. :eyes:
Oliver: Reviewing now. Quick nit: example code block language missing in one snippet. leaving inline comment.
Jin P: Changlog PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/pull/7824 — added release summary and migration notes.
Maria L: Great. If both PRs land and staging smoke is green, I’ll kick the dry-run deploy at 10:25 PT. Everyone standby around 10:20 PT for last checks.
Sam K: :thumbsup: I’ll keep my terminal open.
Oliver: If anything blocks, file a rollback PR and ping me — I’ll coordinate the revert and incident postmortem.
Maria L: Thanks all. Final checklist before I go offline for the night: PRs open ✅, changelog ✅, staging smoke owner assigned ✅, deploy window reserved ✅. Will post a short announce in #general 10:05 PT tomorrow.
Maria L: (Follow-up) If anyone needs to change ownership, call it out here — otherwise we proceed with the plan.
